headline: Kings Cage Erupts as Fishermen's Row and Stlican Shelf Trade Blows
war_summary: The storm has shifted. Kings Cage, little noted in our last edition, now pours out the war's fiercest new toll — better than three thousand casualties in the past two hours, the rate still climbing, with the day's seven base events all logged at Den of Knaves, the latest shortly before this edition went to press. Fishermen's Row keeps its grip on the exchange ledger: seven more base events inside two hours, Dankana Post the busiest of all, and the Colonials now hold three of nine works to the Wardens' six. Stlican Shelf bleeds at an accelerating pace, its latest base movement recorded at filing time, while Tempest Island saw fresh fighting at Isle of Psyche in the same hour. Linn Mercy, which led our last edition with twenty-nine base events, has slowed to a trickle, ten of its eleven works now Warden-held. The Deadlands remain the bloodiest field, some thirty-four thousand lost there in a day, though the two-hour pace has eased and no base event has been recorded since midmorning. Endless Shore has gone quiet since morning and Stonecradle's late flare has cooled, but the Weathered Expanse, untouched on the base ledger, still feeds the casualty columns.
